text: Treats the contradiction between sub-900ms handler logs and gateway 504s as the central clue, meaning time is spent outside the measured handler span
Flags the 3-of-12 pod clustering as evidence against a vendor-wide cause and toward a per-pod condition such as connection pool exhaustion, a bad node, or uneven load balancing
Flags the Monday read-replica change as the leading correlate of the Tuesday onset despite no API deploy, and proposes testing whether connection pooling or routing changed
Pushes back on the vendor theory and the retry wrapper as unsupported by the evidence, noting a retry would multiply load and could worsen a pool-exhaustion cause
Names a concrete environment or configuration difference to verify, such as staging having fewer pods, no read replica, or different pool sizing
Names the specific missing measurement that would settle it, for example queue or wait time before handler entry, connection pool saturation metrics, or per-pod latency breakdown
Output is organized around the debugging loop (Observe, Hypothesize, Predict, Test, Conclude) or names specific Agans rules
Hypotheses are presented as an explicit ranked or enumerated list with testability noted
